description.value: ZipZone Peachland is an adventure park perched above Deep Creek Gorge near Peachland, BC, featuring six ziplines described as among Canada's highest, longest, and fastest at 381 feet above the gorge. Beyond ziplining, the site offers a dynamic climbing wall, ninja course, and games area. Access requires driving a partly rough road for the final 2 km to the site.

address.value: 5875 Brenda Mines Rd, Peachland, British Columbia V0H 1X1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides address, phone, and GPS coordinates consistent with OSM. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site. OSM community field says 'Naramata' but the business address and name both indicate Peachland — a discrepancy worth flagging.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Naramata' but the business address and name indicate Peachland — the OSM record may be mis-attributed to the wrong community.
The last 2 km of the access road are described as rough in user testimonials, which may pose a challenge for road or touring bikes.
None of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website; directory listing will show all three as unknown.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: ZipZone Peachland is a legitimate, operating tourist attraction in the Okanagan that touring cyclists may seek out as a destination activity; its presence in a cycling tourism directory adds value as a notable regional experience.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM has no address, phone, or email tags; all contact details sourced from website contact page. GPS coordinates on website (49.7655, -119.8239) match OSM node coordinates closely.
